categories.name: Human Voice

patterns.label: Negative parallelisms
patterns.comment: No "not just X — it’s Y" constructions. Reads like a person wrote it.

patterns.label: Tailing negations
patterns.comment: No trailing ", not X" corrections — sentences commit to their point.

patterns.label: AI-flag vocabulary
patterns.comment: 0 AI-flag words in 2687 words — vocabulary looks human.

patterns.label: Rule-of-three triads
patterns.comment: 2 "X, Y, and Z" triads (0.7/1k words) — normal range.

patterns.label: Signposting filler
patterns.comment: No filler signposts ("it’s important to note", "in conclusion"…). Every sentence earns its place.

patterns.label: Vague attributions
patterns.comment: No unsourced "experts say / studies show" claims.

patterns.label: Second-person lock
patterns.comment: "You/your" appears 77 times (28.7/1k words) — leaning on direct address. Mix in named examples and first-person experience.

patterns.label: Copula substitutes
patterns.comment: Plain "is/are" doing its job — no dressed-up copulas.

patterns.label: Empty intensifiers
patterns.comment: 0 intensifiers in 2687 words — restrained, credible tone.

patterns.label: Participial pile-ups
patterns.comment: 3 sentences open with an "-ing" phrase (2% of sentences) — healthy variety.

patterns.label: Significance inflation
patterns.comment: No unearned importance claims — significance is shown, not asserted.

patterns.label: Hedging
patterns.comment: 3 hedges in 2687 words — the text commits to its claims.

patterns.label: Semicolon rate
patterns.comment: 3 semicolons (1.1/1k words) — normal for web copy.

patterns.label: Em-dash rate
patterns.comment: 0 em/en dashes (0/1k words) — within human range.

patterns.label: Salesy language
patterns.comment: No hype vocabulary — the copy sells with substance.

patterns.label: Repeated arguments
patterns.comment: 25 three-word phrases repeat (10× for the worst). Repetition signals template writing — consolidate duplicate points.

categories.summary: Human-sounding: 14 of 16 detectors clean. AI engines and readers both reward this.
